correctness.rationale: The explicit generator on all seven transient nonempty occupancy states yields a rational Cramer-rule formula for the center-seeded mean absorption time. Both determinant identities are exact coefficientwise integer-polynomial equalities in the included standalone checker; stochastic scaling gives arbitrary positive extinction rate. Factored endpoint differences are strictly signed throughout the entire feasible product interval, with separate verification of equality cases at C=mu. No empirical or finite-grid extrapolation is needed.

originality.rationale: The new claim is a sharp exact budget-dependent topology switch, with all three maximizers at the critical ratio, in a three-patch spatially resolved stochastic colonization model. Full relevant primary text for Vuilleumier and Possingham 2006 was inspected; older budget studies were checked via abstracts and attempted lawful full-text access but remain unresolved scientific coverage risks. Similar models and general Markov-chain solvers do not by themselves imply the fixed-budget classification.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural design rule for the smallest habitat graph with a meaningful choice between two independently fundable corridors. The exact switch at total colonization intensity equal to local extinction intensity demonstrates a nontrivial connectivity-versus-concentration tradeoff; below it, deleting one corridor is optimal, above it balancing is uniquely optimal. All equality cases and exact persistence differences are supplied. The fact is motivated by species-reintroduction corridor budgeting rather than an arbitrary finite slice, but remains model-specific and not field validated.
